finding_1.title: Hourly Demand Pattern
finding_1.business_significance: Peak demand is concentrated in morning (7-9 AM) and evening (6-9 PM) windows; inventory replenishment and shelf staging should prioritize these periods.

finding_2.title: Category Demand Distribution
finding_2.business_significance: Demand is concentrated in fresh produce and dairy; high-velocity categories should receive greater forecasting and inventory tracking priority.

finding_3.title: Weekday vs Weekend Demand
finding_3.business_significance: Weekend daily demand is substantially higher than weekday demand; replenishment schedules can anticipate weekend volume patterns.
